newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's Lafarge cement firm profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's Lafarge cement firm profit rises.

text.p: Morocco's Lafarge Ciments group, which holds 42 percent of the market, said on Thursday it posted a net profit of 152 million dirhams ($16.5 million) in 1996 from 135 million dirhams ($14.6 million) in 1995.
Turnover for 1996 was 1.67 billion dirhams from 1.55 billion dirhams the year before, the group said in a statement.

Holding Lafarge Ciment is made up of Lafarge Ciment, which includes cement firms Cinouca and Cadem since January 1996, has interests in two cement firms in the northern cities of Tangier and Tetuan, the statement said.
French group Lafarge Coppee together with Morocco's conglomerate Societe Nationale d'Investissement own 50 percent of Lafarge Maroc.
One of the 47 stocks listed on the Casablanca stock exchange, it was last traded at 1,360 dirhams.
